blocks.text: Butcher Boy has officially earned a Bib Gourmand distinction in the 2027 MICHELIN Guide Philippines, advancing from its previous status as a Michelin-Selected Restaurant in the 2026 Michelin Guide. The announcement was made during the official awarding ceremony at the Manila Marriott Hotel, which highlighted the country’s evolving dining scene with the presence of no less than the President of the Republic of the Philippines, His Excellency President Ferdinand Bong Bong Marcos Jr. Butcher Boy was one of only two establishments promoted from the Michelin Selected (recommended) category to a Bib Gourmand Award this year, recognizing its continued commitment to food […]...
